messages.subject: Stan in Wikipedia
parts:
It seems that Stan article in Wikipedia is bit out of date. I think it would be good to update the Wikipedia article after each release so that all new features are advertised and to show that the project is active. There seem to be also some inaccurate descriptions of Stan in probabilistic programming pages (if someone has time and energy to fix these).

Aki
